text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 125 Kenilworth Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 4, 2025) for 125 Kenilworth Avenue, Folder Number 25 218189 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to February 28, 2026.
